title: Kong expands AI management with cost controls and Token Vault
summary: Kong expanded AI Management in Kong Konnect with general-availability AI cost management and Token Vault capabilities, adding spend attribution and runtime credential brokering alongside broader discovery, governance and observability. The release strengthens Kong's agentic-AI platform breadth and monetization surface, but the thesis score remains 69 because Kong disclosed no customer adoption, pricing, bookings, ARR, margin or revenue contribution.
confirmed: Kong announced an expanded AI Management offering in Kong Konnect on November 4, 2026, spanning AI discovery, traffic management, identity, credentials, cost management and observability.
Kong announced general availability of AI cost management for Kong AI Gateway, including attribution of AI consumption to teams, applications and agents across models and providers.
Kong announced general availability of Token Vault for Kong Identity, which brokers downstream credentials at runtime so agents do not need direct access to those credentials.
uncertain: The announcements do not disclose named new customers, adoption metrics, pricing, bookings, ARR, growth, gross margin, retention, cash flow or revenue contribution.
The commercial impact and competitive durability of the new capabilities remain unproven until customer usage and financial evidence are disclosed.
